name: apollo
description: Instance-based multiplayer game server engine: baseapp hosts authoritative player state (anchor/save/session), cellapp runs scenes & instances (dungeon, room, match, tower defense, arena), gateway keeps client connections alive across restarts. Co-op/PvE/PvP and instance-oriented MMO; no ghost or seamless-world machinery.

paragraphs: An instance-based multiplayer game server engine.

Apollo is a lightweight, scalable game server runtime for building instance-based multiplayer games, including co-op games, PvE/PvP instances, dungeon systems, tower defense, arena games, and instance-oriented MMO architectures.
features: Minimalist constructor-injection DI - apollo::core::di: type-keyed bean graph, topologically ordered assembly, ApplicationHost frame-driven lifecycle
Entity contract system - XML+XSD contracts + standalone generator apollogen; the generator is not in the runtime link graph
Async networking - non-blocking sockets + select()/epoll event loop (Windows polls via select(); no IOCP)
Transport codec (target state) - protobuf reflection as default + zstd (planned); the current implementation uses hand-written encoding
AOI 3×3 grid - SceneAoi single implementation + ViewerState per-observer watermarks; the event surface is delivered

whatItDoes.text: An instance-based multiplayer game server engine.
